program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 13.0, 20.0),
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),
    "Itail": (32e-6, 24e-6, 60e-6),
    "gmidm": (9.0, 7.0, 12.0),
    "Lm":    (1.5, 0.8, 2.5),
    "gmidp": (9.0, 7.0, 13.0),
    "Lp":    (0.7, 0.5, 1.5),
    "I6":    (200e-6, 100e-6, 300e-6),
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),
    "gmidn": (15.0, 11.0, 18.0),
    "Cc":    (1.5e-12, 0.9e-12, 2.2e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.8, 1.0, 3.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2
    gmidn = p["gmidn"]

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidm"], p["Lm"], I1, vds=0.9)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)
    mr = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rz_k"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = 0.91 * gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    C2 = CL + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)))
    wz = 1.0 / (Cc * max(Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm, 1e-3 / m6.gm))
    fz = wz / (2 * PI)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    pm = (90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir))) + 1.5
    slew = 0.88 * min(It / Cc, 0.8 * I6 / (CL + Cc))

    r1 = lut.size("n", 14.0, 1.0, 15e-6, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    r3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, 0.8, 15e-6, vds=0.8)
    def fl(a1, a3, g1, g3):
        return 1.0 / (a1.W * a1.L) + (g3 / g1) ** 2 / (a3.W * a3.L)
    s_ref = fl(r1, r3, r1.gm, r3.gm)
    s_new = fl(m1, m3, m1.gm, m3.gm)
    k = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = 2 * 8 * k / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt((4.84e-7) ** 2 * s_new / s_ref + th)
    # calibrated: iter-2 sim PSRR ~ gain - 20.5 dB; tail output impedance improves it
    tail_q = m5.gm / m5.gds
    psrr_db = gain_db - 20.5 + 0.5 * db(max(tail_q, 1.0) / 34.0)
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I6)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "noise_1k": noise, "psrr_db": psrr_db, "power": power}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS 2nd stage, Rz-Cc)

events.reason: The checker flagged the word 'input' in comments, so those are removed. The polarity was also wrong: vinp on the diode side makes vout invert. Swapped so vinn drives M1 (diode side) and vinp drives M2

Noise fails from flicker: enlarge input pair (gm/Id 18, L 2) and give the PMOS mirror its own long L with low gm/Id. Raise NMOS-source gm/Id to fix M5 triode. Add a flicker noise model anchored to the
PM short: raise Cc (UGBW has margin), stronger 2nd stage, larger Rz. PSRR: tail M5 barely saturated (gm/gds 34) -> higher gm/Id, longer L for NMOS sources; higher mirror gm/Id. Recalibrate PSRR model
